text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And sooo... it's decided that our
all-grades mixer will be a Party Night
filled with singing and eating~☆

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
We have events like the soirées, but we never
really had a place to mingle casually.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a wonderful opportunity. It'd be so sad
to attend the same academy yet finish our time here
without ever getting to know someone!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Even if you want to make friends,
it's tough when you're in different grades. People might
worry that talking to them would be a bother, too.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
If we make participation optional, only those who want
to socialize will gather, making it easy to talk... Yeah.
You came up with the best plan, Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, of courrrse♪
It just came to me out of nowhere last night.
I mean, am I a genius or what~~~?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
The issue is probably the date and venue.
It'd be great if we could borrow the gymnasium on a day off.
We'll need to discuss the budget as well.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In that case,
let's go ask the teacher!
Hope we get a good answer~☆

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text: Rejected.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
W-Why is that?
It's true that preparations will be tough,
but we'll all cooperate—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! This was my
suuuper-duper genius idea, you know?!
It'll totally work!

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
I'd have to consult with the other grade heads as well, but...
If it's just mingling, can't you do that without
putting together such an elaborate project?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
B-But creating that opportunity is what's tough...
I mean, when it involves all grade levels,
it's really difficult.

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
The more people involved, the more taxing the preparation becomes.
You should know that from watching or participating in soirées, right?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Th-That is... yes... that's true.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Besides, wanting to hold it on a weekend evening...
There are safety concerns, so
we'd need an adult present.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's whyyy... we thought it'd be great
if you teachers could come too...

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
Coming in on days off poses
various issues for the faculty as well...

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Besides, quizzes are coming up soon, aren't they?
Do you really have time to be partying?
Oh, right, Pandora-san, what about your homework?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft consoled a dejected Fusaichi Pandora.
It looked as though they would have to disband for now, but—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey! Let's continue the discussion!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san...
Is your phone call all right?
Was it an emergency...?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nope, it's fine! There was just something
I wanted to get in touch about beforehand.
I'm done now, so allow me to join in.

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to join, the discussion is over.
You have both studying and training to do.
It's about time you—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, you're looking out for us!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think this project could serve as
a crucial place for both our studies
and our training?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
We can build relationships where we make up
for each other's shortcomings, after all!

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... well...
I mean, I won't deny that aspect, but
there are other problems at hand.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I heard.
First was the issue of preparation
when the headcount increases, correct?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! That phone call just now...
When I contacted my friends,
they agreed to gather helpers for us.

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
Y-You were already setting things in motion...?! 
No, but in the first place, having only students
raises safety concerns.

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. No matter how dependable you girls are,
as teachers and adults, we can't just leave you unsupervised—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, thanks! That's wonderful.
In that case, we must make our sincere
request to you all!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Many students eager to learn will surely attend this mixer.
We would absolutely love for you teachers to watch over us!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, but we can't allocate much budget, can we?
If they have to prepare food and everything themselves,
won't that be overwhelming...?

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
Ah... if it's homemade, food hygiene management
will also become necessary, along with
various other minor issues that might crop up...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm, great progress!
Let's write down all the points of concern!
All for the sake of the best party.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm so glad the teachers are getting
motivated too. To think we'd get
so much constructive feedback.

text_block_list.name: Grade Dean
text_block_list.text:
Eh. No, it's not like we're... um.
...Hmm... well, I suppose.
We could give it some consideration...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, huh?
You mean... we can actually
have our Party Night...?!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
...All their objections
got turned into constructive advice...

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, perspective really is everything!
Heart-san... you're simply amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Driven forward by Dearing Heart, the event was held.
And the delightful mixer turned out to be a resounding success.
